'''The Dagger Hills''' is actually a ridge, sitting behind [[Moonbrook]] in [[Westfall]]. The area is also called Southern Westfall.<ref>{{questlong|Alliance|17|The People's Militia (3)|The People's Militia}}</ref> Nowadays the hills are home to [[Defias Knuckleduster]]s, [[Defias Pathstalker]]s, and [[Defias Highwayman|Defias Highwaymen]]. [[Grimbooze Thunderbrew]] can also be found here, and [[Leprithus]] the [[ghoul]] can also arise in the area.
